title: Historical report media
responsibility: Converts older report references and media without presenting them as build-bound verification.

inputs.name: legacyLink.report
inputs.description: A pre-Git report record used to read its linked revision or, when that is absent, its gap explanation. This function does not inspect the report's media list.

examples.title: Historical report media
examples.gap: The report contains no additional commit explanation.
examples.summary: Historical report media captured for the reports explorer.

examples.title: Legacy capture gaps
examples.gap: The legacy report did not name a repository commit.
examples.summary: Legacy captures were retained with a missing media file.

inputs.name: legacyLink.commit
inputs.description: The commit currently being compared with report.linked. Exact equality selects the fixed same-commit label; the requested commit is not shortened.

inputs.name: legacyEvidence.report
inputs.description: A pre-Git report record whose media entries are converted in their original order. Its linked revision and gap text are copied into attribution; the conversion does not claim a build association.

examples.title: Historical report media
examples.gap: The report contains no additional commit explanation.
examples.summary: Historical report media captured for the reports explorer.

examples.title: Legacy capture gaps
examples.gap: The legacy report did not name a repository commit.
examples.summary: Legacy captures were retained with a missing media file.

media.title: Recorder output
media.gap: The media file was not retained.

outputs.name: legacyLink
outputs.description: Text describing how the legacy report relates to the requested commit. It returns a fixed label for an exact match, a shortened linked revision otherwise, or the report gap/default when no revision is linked.
examples: The legacy report did not name a repository commit.

outputs.name: legacyEvidence
outputs.description: Legacy media converted to ordered gallery records with legacy standing and provenance that says no build was recorded. Unknown statuses become not-proven, only a leading media/ prefix is removed from a file path, audio-prefixed MIME types select audio presentation, and missing is true only when media is null.

examples.title: Reports explorer home

provenance.value: not recorded: legacy reports name no build

examples.note: Recorded by legacy report rpt-2024-06-01 (passed) before records were kept in Git. It named revision 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567.

examples.title: Recorder output

provenance.label: Captured from
provenance.value: not recorded: legacy reports name no build

provenance.label: Recorded by
provenance.value: legacy report rpt-2024-06-02, linked to no commit

examples.note: Recorded by legacy report rpt-2024-06-02 (failed) before records were kept in Git. The legacy report did not name a repository commit. The media file was not retained.
